coverage.notes: SEL: RI SEL Standards: Competencies for School and Life Success (5 anchor standards, 23 learning standards), endorsed by the Council on Elementary and Secondary Education Oct 24, 2017, applying Preschool through Adult. RIDE's May 2019 introduction says the Council approved them but districts are NOT required to implement them (a model for districts). POG: no statewide Portrait of a Graduate document was found or opened, so none is recorded; status left 'unknown' because ride.ri.gov web pages returned 403 to our fetch tool (only PDFs could be read). RIDE's 2018 Secondary Regulations Reference Guide quotes the 2020 Vision for Education's one-sentence ideal graduate (think critically and collaboratively; creative, self-motivated, culturally competent learner and citizen); the 2023 Social Studies Framework repeats similar wording from the 2021-2027 Strategic Plan. Neither is a portrait with named attributes. Reviewer: look for a newer RIDE graduate profile.

frameworks.name: Rhode Island Social Emotional Learning Standards: Competencies for School and Life Success
frameworks.issuingBody: Rhode Island Department of Education (endorsed by the Council on Elementary and Secondary Education)
frameworks.notes: Endorsed Oct 24, 2017 (stated on the standards chart). Per RIDE's May 2019 'Introduction and Guidance' PDF (https://ride.ri.gov/Portals/0/Uploads/Documents/Students-and-Families-Great-Schools/Health-Safety/Social-Emotional-Learning/SEL-Intro-3-15-19.pdf), endorsement means districts are not required to implement; the five anchors follow CASEL's five competencies. Items are all 23 learning standards (1A-5E); titles and summaries are short paraphrases of the chart's wording. RIDE also publishes separate SEL Indicators by grade span (not itemized here). CASEL tags follow the anchor standard each item sits under.

items.title: Understand one's own emotions
items.summary: Individual demonstrates an understanding of one's emotions.

items.title: Know when help is needed and who can give it
items.summary: Identify when help is needed and who can provide it.

items.title: Know one's personal rights and responsibilities
items.summary: Show awareness of one's own personal rights and responsibilities.

items.title: Know one's strengths, cultural and linguistic assets, and aspirations
items.summary: Show knowledge of one's own personal strengths, cultural and linguistic assets, and aspirations.

items.title: Identify one's own prejudices and biases
items.summary: Seek to understand and identify one's own prejudices and biases.

items.title: Manage emotions, thoughts, impulses and stress constructively
items.summary: Show the skills to manage emotions, thoughts, impulses and stress in constructive ways.

items.title: Manage materials, space, time and responsibilities
items.summary: Manage materials, space, time and responsibilities effectively.

items.title: Develop, evaluate, modify and achieve goals
items.summary: Show skills to develop, evaluate, modify and achieve goals.

items.title: Keep a resilient attitude and growth mindset
items.summary: Show a resilient attitude and growth mindset even in the face of adversity and challenges.

items.title: Read social cues and respond appropriately
items.summary: Read social cues and respond appropriately.

items.title: Respect people with diverse backgrounds, abilities and identities
items.summary: Seek to understand and show respect for individuals with diverse backgrounds, cultures, abilities, languages and identities.

items.title: Show empathy for others' emotions and perspectives
items.summary: Show empathy for other people's emotions and perspectives.

items.title: Recognize and respect leadership in oneself and others
items.summary: Recognize and respect leadership capacity in oneself and others.

items.title: Contribute productively to school, family, workplace and community
items.summary: Contribute productively to one's school, family, workplace and community.

items.title: Communicate and interact effectively with diverse others
items.summary: Use communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with others, including those with diverse backgrounds, cultures, abilities, languages and identities.

items.title: Use communication skills to maintain relationships
items.summary: Use appropriate communication strategies and interpersonal skills to maintain relationships.

items.title: Respectfully engage in and resolve interpersonal conflicts
items.summary: Show the skills to respectfully engage in and resolve interpersonal conflicts in various contexts.

items.title: Recognize when others need help; give or seek assistance
items.summary: Recognize when others need help and show the ability to provide or seek assistance.

items.title: Apply problem-solving skills responsibly
items.summary: Apply problem-solving skills to engage responsibly in a variety of situations.

items.title: Use and adapt tools and strategies to solve problems
items.summary: Use and adapt appropriate tools and strategies to solve problems.

items.title: Evaluate the impact of decisions and adjust behavior
items.summary: Evaluate the impact of decisions on self, others and the situation, and adjust behavior appropriately.

items.title: Consider ethical, safety and societal factors in decisions
items.summary: Consider ethical, safety and societal factors when making choices and decisions.

items.title: Respond to outside influences on decisions
items.summary: Consider and respond appropriately to external influences (for example media, peers, authority figures) on decision-making.

alignments.rationale: FNE lesson "Stay in Control of Your Spirit" (series: Conflict & Self-Government; the objective is the same in every grade version). FNE's stated objective: "Learners will identify signs that emotions are beginning to take control, practice a simple pause-and-reset process, and choose one respectful action that keeps their response aligned with their values." Students recognise when emotions start driving behaviour and choose a response, which is understanding one's own emotions and how they connect to actions.
